milestones.title: Problem file and `problem check`
milestones.statement: `problem check <file>` accepts every valid problem file in GOAL.md and refuses each invalid one with exit 1 and one line that names the bad field.

milestones.title: `solve` runs the loop on any problem
milestones.statement: `solve <file>` measures the baseline, runs rounds with the proposer, keeps a change only when the measure improves, commits kept changes to synthe/solve-<name>-<n>, leaves the working tree and current branch unchanged, and writes result.json and report.md as GOAL.md says.

milestones.title: Outside proposer protocol
milestones.statement: Synthe talks to an outside proposer command exactly as GOAL.md says: the stdin object, the stdout object, empty proposals stop the run, and bad JSON or a non-matching search becomes a failed attempt with a reason instead of a crash.

milestones.title: Any language, no package.json
milestones.statement: `solve` improves a Python project and a plain shell-script project that have no package.json, with measure and guard commands in those languages.

milestones.title: Artifacts that are not code
milestones.statement: `solve` improves a JSON configuration (parameter tuning), a Markdown document scored by a script, and a CSV data file cleaned to raise a quality score.

milestones.title: Honest decisions on noisy measures
milestones.statement: With a noisy measure, `solve` keeps a no-op change in no more than 5% of seeded runs, and keeps a real gain of two noise standard deviations in at least 80% of seeded runs when runs is 5.

milestones.title: Held-back split
milestones.statement: With split.holdout true, a change that wins on train only (it memorizes the train cases) is refused, a change that wins on both is kept, and the proposer never receives a holdout number.

milestones.title: Protected and outside paths
milestones.statement: A proposal that edits a protect path, the measure command's files, or a file outside artifact is refused with a reason that names the path, and the file does not change.

milestones.title: Judged measures
milestones.statement: With measure.judge, Synthe asks every comparison twice with a and b swapped, keeps a change the judge truly prefers, and refuses a change that wins only through the judge's position or length bias.

milestones.title: Guards
milestones.statement: A change that raises the score but makes a guard command fail is refused, and the reason names the guard. A guard that fails on the baseline stops setup with exit 1.

milestones.title: Several candidates in each round
milestones.statement: When candidates is more than 1, the proposer gets that number, every proposal is measured, and the round keeps at most one: the best one that passes the decision rule.

milestones.title: Memory across runs
milestones.statement: A second `solve` run of the same problem sends the proposer the history of the first run, with each attempt's summary, kept flag and reason.

milestones.title: Budget and stop rules
milestones.statement: `solve` stops on max_rounds, on max_calls, on an empty proposal list, and after 3 rounds in a row that keep nothing, and result.json gives the stop reason in plain words.

milestones.title: Zoo bench
milestones.statement: `npm run bench -- --zoo` runs `solve` on every problem in swarm/zoo/ with seeds 1, 2 and 3, prints one row for each problem, and writes bench/zoo-results.json with real gains kept, no-ops kept and traps kept.

milestones.title: Synthe as its own problem
milestones.statement: synthe.self.json at the repository root is a valid problem file that points Synthe at its own src/, measures with `npm run bench -- --score` (which prints one number), guards with typecheck and tests, and protects bench/, test/, swarm/ and spec/.

milestones.title: Model proposer for any problem
milestones.statement: With proposer "model" and an OpenAI-compatible provider, Synthe builds the proposer request from the same stdin object, parses the reply into proposals, and turns a malformed reply into a failed attempt with a reason.

milestones.title: Synthe solves the zoo
milestones.statement: Across every zoo problem and seeds 1, 2 and 3, `solve` keeps at least 80% of the real gains, keeps no trap, and keeps no more than 1 no-op in total.
